policy.resolution_rule: A public-consultation notice and its elapsed comment deadline do not establish a final launch, an OPEN submission state, a submission deadline or any final-guide material fact. Every material class remains UNKNOWN until the final package is retrieved, hash-pinned and semantically reviewed together with an explicit current MySMIS submission window or an authoritative cancellation notice.

evidence.source_owner: Organismul Intermediar Regional pentru Programul Educație și Ocupare — Regiunea Nord-Vest
evidence.semantic_assertion: The official OIR Nord-Vest announcement dated 2026-07-17 states that AM PEO launched the Universități deschise guide in public consultation, identifies actions 7.e.5 and 7.e.6, and links the MIPE consultation ZIP. It establishes consultation identity only; it does not establish a final guide, current submission window, OPEN status, budget, grant, cumulative eligibility, scoring or beneficiaries.

evidence.source_owner: Organismul Intermediar Regional pentru Programul Educație și Ocupare — Regiunea Vest
evidence.semantic_assertion: The official OIR Vest notice dated 2026-07-16 states that comments on the Universități deschise guide were accepted through 2026-08-05 and links the MIPE guide page. The elapsed consultation-comment deadline is not a project-submission deadline and proves none of the seven publishable material fact classes.

status.reason: The official notices establish public consultation only; no final launch, explicit current submission state or cancellation was verified.

deadline.reason: 2026-08-05 is the consultation-comment deadline, not a project-submission deadline.

budget.reason: The final guide package could not be retrieved, hash-pinned and semantically reviewed.

grant.reason: No authoritative final project-level grant, value limits or co-financing rules were verified.

eligibility.reason: The cumulative final applicant, partner, activity and exclusion rules were not verified from an accessible final package.

scoring.reason: No final evaluation grid, thresholds or tie-breakers were retrieved and hash-pinned.

beneficiaries.reason: The consultation title and summaries do not establish the complete final applicant, partner and target-group rules.

resolution_tasks.resolution_note: All seven classes remain UNKNOWN. Re-review only when MIPE publishes an accessible hash-pinnable final Universități deschise package plus an explicit MySMIS submission window, an authoritative final launch notice, or a cancellation notice.
